description: This PHP source file defines the class TestCaseParams within the namespace OrangeHRM\\Tests\\Util\\Integration. The class is used to encapsulate parameters and configurations for integration test cases in the OrangeHRM project, including properties for test names, user IDs, services, attributes, expected results, exceptions, and hooks.

classes.name: TestCaseParams
classes.description: A class representing test case parameters for integration tests within the OrangeHRM project. It includes properties for test metadata, expected results, exceptions, and hooks, as well as getter and setter methods for these properties.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the test case.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the test case.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the test case.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the test case.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Returns the services used in the test case.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Sets the services for the test case.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Returns the factories used in the test case.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Sets the factories for the test case.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes used in the test case.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for the test case.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the body data for the test case.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the body data for the test case.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query parameters for the test case.

methods.name: getResultData
methods.description: Returns the expected result data for the test case.

methods.name: setResultData
methods.description: Sets the expected result data for the test case.

methods.name: getResultMeta
methods.description: Returns the expected result metadata for the test case.

methods.name: setResultMeta
methods.description: Sets the expected result metadata for the test case.

methods.name: getInvalidOnly
methods.description: Returns data indicating which parts of the test case are invalid.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Returns whether the test case is marked as invalid.

methods.name: setInvalidOnly
methods.description: Sets data indicating the invalid parts of the test case.

methods.name: getExceptionClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the expected exception.

methods.name: setExceptionClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the expected exception.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Returns the expected exception message.

methods.name: setExceptionMessage
methods.description: Sets the expected exception message.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the DateTime object representing the current time used in the test.

methods.name: setNowFromArray
methods.description: Sets the DateTime object based on an array with 'datetime' and optional 'timezone' keys.

methods.name: getHooks
methods.description: Returns the hooks associated with the test case.

methods.name: getHook
methods.description: Returns a specific hook callable by name.

methods.name: setHooks
methods.description: Sets multiple hooks for the test case.
